apiDocs.title: API Documentation
apiDocs.description: Operate every feature over the HTTP API — ideal for scripts and automation
apiDocs.authDesc: All endpoints except health check and login/setup require one of these headers:
apiDocs.jwtLabel: JWT (issued after web login, valid 7 days)
apiDocs.rateLimitNote: Auth endpoints are rate-limited to 10 requests/min/IP. Batch endpoints run synchronously and may take minutes (the frontend times out after 300s while the backend keeps running).
apiDocs.realCallNote: Requests are executed for real against this deployment using your current admin login.

healthz.detail: No auth required. Returns ok, the service name and a server timestamp. Use it for liveness probes, monitoring and systemd/Docker health checks.

auth_status.detail: No auth required. Returns isInitialized: false means the master password is not set yet (call setup first); true means use login.

auth_setup.summary: First-time setup of the master password
auth_setup.detail: Only works before initialization (repeat calls get 400). Master password min 12 chars, stored as an Argon2id hash; on success a JWT is returned and you are logged in. Rate limited to 10/min/IP.

auth_login.detail: Verifies the master password, derives the AES key that unlocks encrypted fields, and issues a 7-day HS256 JWT. Wrong password returns 401. Send Authorization: Bearer afterwards. Rate limited as above.

auth_change_password.detail: Verifies the old password, then re-encrypts every account token/password/email with the new key — any failure rolls everything back. Requires auth. New password min 12 chars.

accounts_list.detail: Returns all non-deleted accounts. Raw token/password/email never appear — only masked fields. ?group= filters by group; sorting and pinning are handled client-side.

accounts_get.detail: Single account (same fields as the list, masked secrets), including accounts in the recycle bin.

accounts_secrets.detail: Decrypts and returns the plaintext GitHub token, password and recovery email. Fails while the master key is locked (after a restart, before login). Never expose this to untrusted scripts.

accounts_import.detail: Submits a GitHub PAT: the backend validates it against /user (login, avatar, scopes) and stores it encrypted. A soft-deleted account with the same login is revived and its token updated. password/recovery_email/note/group are optional.

accounts_update.detail: note and group are cleared when set to an empty string; password and recovery_email are only updated when non-empty (cannot be cleared). Omitted fields stay unchanged.

accounts_delete.detail: Soft delete: moves the account to the recycle bin and disables all its scheduled tasks. Recoverable within the retention window; cleaned up permanently afterwards.

accounts_restore.detail: Clears the deleted flag and re-enables all scheduled tasks of the account.

accounts_check.detail: Runs ban detection: concurrent GitHub /user API call and profile page fetch. Any abnormal signal marks banned; 401 bad credentials marks token_expired. Result and reason are persisted and returned.

accounts_batch_check.detail: Runs detection for ids (max 100) sequentially and returns per-id results. Large batches can take minutes.

accounts_batch_check_group.detail: Runs detection for every account in a group; empty group = all accounts. Returns results and total.

accounts_groups.detail: Returns all group names in use (deduplicated, empty excluded).

accounts_repos.detail: Local repository cache for the account — no live GitHub call. Call refresh first for fresh data.

accounts_repos_refresh.detail: Fetches every repo visible to the token (personal + orgs + collaborations) with pagination, upserts them, then scans workflows automatically. Returns the total.

accounts_scan_workflows.detail: Walks all repos (skips archived/disabled), stores workflow definitions and latest run status.

accounts_recycle_bin_delete.detail: Physically deletes the account together with its repos/workflows/tasks. Not recoverable.

accounts_recycle_bin_clean.detail: Permanently deletes accounts soft-deleted longer than the retention period (default 30 days). Returns the cutoff date.

repos_contents.detail: path is relative to the repo root (empty = root); ref defaults to the default branch. :id is the local repo record ID (from accounts/:id/repos), not the GitHub ID.

repos_file_get.detail: Returns path, sha, content (base64) and encoding — the basis of the built-in file editor.

repos_file_put.detail: content is base64; message is the commit message; existing files are updated by sha automatically. Returns the new commit sha.

repos_workflows_list.detail: Locally cached workflows with their latest run status; populated by refresh / scan-workflows.

repos_workflows_create.detail: Creates a file under .github/workflows/. filename must be a bare .yml/.yaml name (no paths, no ..).

repos_dispatch.detail: Triggers workflow_dispatch. inputs must match the workflow definition (query workflow-inputs first); the workflow must declare the workflow_dispatch trigger.

repos_workflow_inputs.detail: Parses the workflow YAML and returns the workflow_dispatch.inputs definition (name/description/required/default/type/choices). Returns an empty array when parsing fails.

runs_list.detail: Returns total_count and the latest runs. status: queued/in_progress/completed; conclusion: success/failure/cancelled/skipped.

runs_jobs.detail: All jobs of one run, including each step's status and conclusion.

runs_logs_url.detail: The zip log URL obtained from GitHub's 302 redirect — a short-lived signed link; use it promptly.

runs_job_logs.detail: The backend follows the redirect and returns the full plain-text log of one job.

runs_cancel.detail: Only queued/in_progress/waiting runs can be cancelled; finished runs return an error.

tasks_list.detail: All tasks with cron, next_run_at, latest result (success/failed/running) and error text.

tasks_create.detail: Fires a workflow_dispatch on schedule. cron is a 5-field expression (min hour dom mon dow); the scheduler scans every 30s; next_run_at is computed on creation.

tasks_update.detail: Partial update of ref/cron_expr/inputs_json/enabled/workflow_filename; changing cron or enabled recomputes next_run_at.

tasks_toggle.detail: Toggles enabled; disabling clears next_run_at, re-enabling recomputes it. Body: {"enabled": bool}.

tasks_run.detail: Fires one run asynchronously — watch last_run_result (running → success/failed). Requires the keystore to be unlocked.

batch_create_workflows.detail: Commits the same workflow file to each repo in repo_ids (≤100), synchronously and serially; content is base64. Failed ids can be retried alone.

batch_dispatch.detail: Triggers workflow_dispatch on each repo. repo_ids total length ≤100 (the UI's per-repo repeat count simply duplicates ids).

batch_create_repos.detail: Creates count (1-50) repos per account (names get -1, -2… suffixes), optionally pushing template files and secrets (encrypted with the repo public key). Synchronous; large batches take minutes.

batch_fetch_template.detail: Pulls every blob of a template repo via the recursive git tree (max 500 files, ≤1MB each) as base64, for use with create-repos.

batch_update_repos.detail: For each repo: deletes all existing files, then copies every file from the template. Two upstream calls per file — slow for big repos. Original content cannot be recovered.

batch_toggle_visibility.detail: Switches all listed repos to the given visibility and updates the local cache. No file changes.

autotask_get.detail: Auto check/sync switches and intervals (minutes), group filters, recycle-bin settings and last-run timestamps.

autotask_update.detail: Intervals are minutes (invalid values fall back to 1440); groups are comma-separated, empty = all; recycle_bin_days is the retention. Takes effect within 30s.

autotask_check_now.detail: Starts one detection round asynchronously and returns ok immediately. A package-level lock prevents overlap — a still-running round causes a skip. Progress via running/logs.

autotask_sync_now.detail: Starts one repo-sync round asynchronously; same anti-overlap behaviour.

autotask_logs.detail: Recent runs: type check/sync, status, total/success/failed counts, duration and detail text. limit ≤200, default 50.

autotask_running.detail: Returns running plus the in-flight log entry; the UI polls every 5s.

stats_overview.detail: Account counts by status (recycle bin excluded), repo/workflow/task counts and enabled tasks. No parameters.

apikeys_list.detail: Prefixes only (first 14 chars) — no full keys, no hashes.

apikeys_create.detail: The full key is returned exactly once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. expires_in_days 0/omitted = never expires.

apikeys_delete.detail: Physically removes the key; scripts using it get 401 immediately.

apikeys_toggle.detail: Disabling blocks authentication instantly; re-enable any time.

system_version.detail: current is injected at build time via -ldflags (dev for local go run), plus GOOS/GOARCH.

system_check_update.detail: Queries the latest GitHub release and compares version strings (not semver); returns has_update, the release URL and notes. Network failure yields has_update:false plus error.

system_update.detail: Downloads the matching platform binary (≤200MB), verifies SHA256SUMS.txt, atomically replaces the binary (keeps .old) and exits for systemd to restart. Brief downtime; not suitable for Docker.

danger.d_change_password: The master password will be changed now and all encrypted fields re-encrypted
danger.d_account_delete: The account moves to the recycle bin and its scheduled tasks are disabled now
danger.d_recycle_delete: The account and its related data will be permanently deleted
danger.d_recycle_clean: Accounts past the retention period will be permanently deleted
danger.d_file_put: This commits once to the real repository
danger.d_workflow_create: This commits a workflow file to the real repository
danger.d_dispatch: This really triggers one GitHub Actions run
danger.d_run_cancel: This really cancels a running Actions run
danger.d_tasks_delete: The task record will be deleted and cannot be recovered
danger.d_batch_create_workflows: Files will really be committed to every selected repo
danger.d_batch_dispatch: This really triggers up to 100 Actions runs
danger.d_batch_create_repos: Repos will really be created under every account and populated
danger.d_batch_update_repos: All existing files of the target repos will be deleted and overwritten by the template — unrecoverable
danger.d_batch_toggle_visibility: The public/private state of the repos will really change
danger.d_apikeys_delete: The key is invalidated immediately; scripts using it get 401
danger.d_system_update: The service downloads a new binary and restarts itself — brief downtime
